selection: Minimum mean validation finite Huber plus candidate soft-rank; final test never selects a checkpoint.
scope: Development multi-goal experiment. Environment supplies complete real successors; independent Q(s), Q(g); no search or candidate pruning.
hypothesis: Six-person paired from-scratch comparison with1024 training time combinations,8 validation and8 test combinations, complete mask/torch multi-goals. Both arms use the same bias-free ReLU MLP with linear output, seed, data draws, losses and budget. Only raw input encoding changes: identity uses times plus binary banks; time_homogeneous uses times, time*bank for each person and max(time)*torch bank. The latter encodes full raw state without labels and implies Q(k*times,state)=k*Q(times,state) for positive k. Scaling law helps costs but does not imply shortest-path accuracy. Existing sigmoid maps are historical references, not the matched control. No inference teacher, search or action filtering.
